changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: A request still waiting for approval needs one more decision, from whoever it is waiting on now. The placeholder rows for the levels above that, which nobody has acted on, are removed, and the request's last level becomes its current one. Decided, rejected, withdrawn and cancelled requests keep their trail exactly as it is.
changeSet.sql:
DELETE FROM leave_approval WHERE action = 'PENDING' AND leave_request_id IN ( SELECT lr.id FROM leave_request lr WHERE lr.status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND lr.current_approval_level IS NOT NULL AND leave_approval.approval_level > lr.current_approval_level );
UPDATE leave_request SET max_approval_level = current_approval_level WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND current_approval_level IS NOT NULL AND max_approval_level > current_approval_level;

rollback.comment: The removed rows recorded no decision, so there is nothing to restore.
